A search dog was brought in and they pulled a baby boy out of the rubble alive nearly 36 hours after the disaster that blew apart his home. He was flown to Moscow in a desperate attempt to save his life. More than 30 people who lived in the building have are still missing. A year ago, on 7 April 2017, my hometown Stockholm was attacked by a terrorist. Here are some of the stories of courage, heroism and humanity! ⬇ Watch Next ⬇
[Playlist] Real Life Heroes 2019 - Faith in Humanity Restored https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KCdJALjDp-A&index=1&list=PLZ588ZQMvJsC1Mddyjt61XlmpuwWTOw88

The terror attack in Stockholm, Sweden left five people (and about 14 injured) and one dog dead. These real life heroes ignored danger & saved lives of co-citizens: by alarming pedestrians about dangerous truck deliberately driven into crowds, helping those who are injured & launching a twitter-campaign to help people find a safe place in a city that for a day became overfull of fear and chaos.
This video was definitely the most difficult to make. Not because of the editing, research & finding video sources or figuring out a way to tell this story (through the eyes of Sweden's biggest hero Zlatan Ibrahimović)... But because of the fact that I was forced to relive that day again and again until this video was finally done. Remembering how I felt when I found out that one of my hometowns is attacked - while I'm being so close to the place where the terror attack took place.
I've made this video in order to share the stories of brave men and women who did their best to protect the citizens; who saved injured people by being in the right place at the right time; who offered their homes to strangers in need of a safe place.
You are my HEROES. Thank you!
